trap.label: modal
trap.wrong: I must to finish this report.
trap.why: Modais não levam to. Must = obrigação interna; have to = externa; be required to = formal (regra).

opts: I must to wear a badge.
I have to wear a badge.
Staff are required to sign in.
I must to call my sister.
I have must call my sister.

fix.right: Drivers are required to wear seatbelts.

fix.wrong: Yesterday I must pay the fee.
fix.right: Yesterday I had to pay the fee.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “I have to wear a badge.”
rewrite.answer: I had to wear a badge.

rewrite.prompt: Formal: “You must sign in.” (are required to)
rewrite.answer: You are required to sign in.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa de have to (não é obrigatório): “He has to pay.”
